text: VIX at 28.18 combined with rising inflation (3.7% CPI), a near-miss on jobs (29k vs 84k forecast), and a Fed that may still hike signals risk-off conditions are building — consider holding extra cash and being very selective with new buys.

QBTS is down 67% with no earnings, burning cash, and 24% short interest — the thesis is broken and holding this is just hoping, so sell and redeploy the remaining capital into something that's actually working.
RGTI has the worst relative strength in your portfolio at -74, is down 64% with shrinking revenue and 21% short interest — there's nothing to wait for here, sell it.
IONQ is down 43% with negative earnings, cash-burning operations, and 12% short interest — in this macro environment speculative money-losers get punished hardest, so exit now.

MSTR is a leveraged Bitcoin bet with negative free cash flow and insiders selling — reduce your position size because this kind of high-volatility speculation adds outsized risk when the VIX is already elevated.
NCLP.L is down 40% with weak relative strength and all technical indicators bearish — trim this ETF position to limit further damage while you reassess whether the underlying thesis still holds.
CNC is your strongest technical holding with relative strength of 79, bullish MACD, and trading above its 50-day average — in a nervous market, leaning into what's actually working makes sense.

Adobe at a PE of just 9 with 10% revenue growth and a 10% free cash flow yield looks genuinely cheap — consider adding on this pullback since the fundamentals strongly support a higher price over time.
